# Obsidian Tasks format examples

These fixtures use the production-supported Tasks emoji syntax.

## Due and completion dates

- [ ] Task due today 📅 2026-05-27
- [ ] Task due next week 📅 2026-06-03
- [ ] Task due next month 📅 2026-06-27
- [x] Completed task 📅 2026-05-26 ✅ 2026-05-27

## Priorities

- [ ] Highest priority task 🔺
- [ ] High priority task ⏫
- [ ] Medium priority task 🔼
- [ ] Normal priority task
- [ ] Low priority task 🔽
- [ ] Lowest priority task ⏬

## Date combinations

- [ ] Task with due and scheduled 📅 2026-06-15 ⏳ 2026-06-10
- [ ] Task with due, scheduled, and start 📅 2026-06-15 ⏳ 2026-06-10 🛫 2026-06-05
- [ ] Task with multiple metadata fields 📅 2026-06-15 🔺 ⏳ 2026-06-10 ⏱️ 2h

## Nested example

- [ ] Deploy to production 📅 2026-06-01 ⏳ 2026-05-29 🔺 ⏱️ 4h
  - [ ] Run tests
  - [ ] Code review
  - [ ] Database migration
- [ ] Monthly report 📅 2026-06-30 ⏫ ⏱️ 3h
  - [ ] Gather metrics
  - [ ] Create charts
